description_en: Changes the resource group of a resource
kebab_example: aliyun dbs change-resource-group --resource-id dbs1jyajqk000000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aekz4kee6000000 --resource-type backupplan --api-version 2021-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to backupplan
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent. This prevents the same request from being submitted multiple times
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region_code

Code.description_en: The status code of the API

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource group was changed. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Data.description_zh:
是否转组成功，返回值如下：

true：成功
false：失败

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息

Message.example: The resource group is forbidden to operate

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
